title: Fix File not found, cause 5: input path

scenes.narration: Cause five: an input path does not match the file on disk.
scenes.caption: The input path is wrong.

scenes.narration: With a dot tex extension in the message, the path in input or include is wrong. Paths are relative to the main file, not to the file that contains the input.
scenes.caption: The file on disk is sections/intro.tex

scenes.narration: Use the name that is on disk.
scenes.caption: \input{sections/intro}

lines: ModernTex flags this as you type. purplelink.llc/moderntex

bumper.note: Purplelink LLC brand bumper at start and end; narration never overlaps the bumpers.
